audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Aurora Level 1 and Irelia Levels 4-5, both contradicting the page's own prose: whys[0] says "neither of you has a real all-in yet" and mid says "Levels 4-5 even out".
audit.why: The packet chart already reads Skill / Irelia / Irelia / Skill / Aurora / Irelia / Irelia, which is exactly what the prose describes and what a 47.18% lane looks like.
audit.corrected: Skill / Irelia / Irelia / Skill / Aurora / Irelia / Irelia, ratings matched. diff stays TRICKY 7.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names none of Irelia's abilities except Flawless Duet, carries no cooldowns, and calls Aurora's ultimate "Between the Worlds".
audit.why: Aurora's ultimate is Between Worlds (140/120/100s). Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at 850. Bladesurge is 10/9/8/7/6s at 600. Vanguard's Edge is 125/105/85s at 950. The Sheen/Trinity spike is what turns a reset into burst.
audit.corrected: Every ability named and the real numbers carried into phases, cooldowns, loading and the report.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claims in six places that Defiant Dance "blocks your Q-recast burst and heals her through it". It does neither.
audit.why: Riot's text for Defiant Dance: she charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges and "takes reduced physical damage during the charge". Aurora deals magic damage, so Defiant Dance does not reduce a single point of your Twofold Hex, Weirding or Between Worlds damage — and it has no heal at all. The healing is on Bladesurge. Telling an Aurora to wait out a W that does nothing to her costs her the only trades she gets. Second correction: Bladesurge's cooldown "refreshes" only if the target is Marked or dies, and Irelia's only Marks are Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge — so denying the E stun denies the champion reset chain outright. Third: the page claims Between Worlds makes you untargetable in four places; the invisibility belongs to Across the Veil.
audit.corrected: Defiant Dance corrected to a physical-damage-reduction charge that does not touch your magic damage; the Mark condition on Bladesurge stated; untargetability reassigned to Across the Veil.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears once, in a line that calls Irelia "his".
audit.why: Bladesurge heals her on every strike and she can chain it off minions, so Grievous Wounds is what makes your poke stick.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds tied to Bladesurge by name in phases[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Irelia is "him"/"his" in breakdown.wave, trading, feeding, late, report[8] and dontsFull[0].d; the "KA answer / a immobile drain bot" line appears four times.

notes: Biggest error here: the page says six times that Defiant Dance blocks Aurora's Q-recast burst and heals Irelia through it. Riot's text says Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge and it has no heal — Aurora deals magic damage, so her burst goes through it untouched, and the healing is on Bladesurge. That reversal was steering the player away from her only good trades. Also stated the real reset condition (Bladesurge refreshes only on a Marked target or a kill; her only Marks are Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge) and removed the Between Worlds untargetability claim. BAD DERIVED FLAG: the kit file tags Flawless Duet with "grounding", but Riot's description is only "damaged, stunned and Marked" — I did not write any grounding interaction. Worth checking that flag across other Irelia pages.
